map.ω = 2π×3000/60 ≈ 314.16 rad/s。即 3000 转/分: ω = 2π×3000/60 ≈ 314.16 rad/s. That is, 3000 rpm is about 314 rad/s.
map.ω=2πn/60=2π×1500/60=157.080 rad/s。电机铭牌的: ω=2πn/60=2π×1500/60=157.080 rad/s. The motor nameplate 1500 rpm is about 25 turns per second.

1 rpm=2π/60≈0.10472 rad/s, conversely 1 rad/s≈9.5493 rpm. For quick estimation remember "multiply rad/s by 10 then subtract 5%" to get roughly rpm; in this example 157.080×9.5493≈1500.
